old_value: The subsystem maintains a two-record rolling state. During a frame, timing setters overwrite their respective fields and instrumentation counters accumulate in HSD_PerfCurrentStat. At the end of the frame, HSD_PerfInitStat atomically at source level promotes that completed record to HSD_PerfLastStat and resets every current timing and counter field to zero. The next frame establishes a new start_time before accumulating another record.
new_value: Timing setters overwrite individual fields without advancing start_time; unsigned work counters accumulate. InitStat performs a record copy followed by zero fill, with no atomicity or synchronization mechanism. The reviewed loop resets start_time per queued update and rotates after total sampling. The signed envelope index is checked only for n < 32; nonnegative input is a caller obligation.
